_scenario.title: TouchDesigner is frozen (a dialog blocks it)
_scenario.description: bitcube is up and the probe answers, but the TD bridge gets no reply within 15 s (td = { ok: false, error: "no answer from the TD bridge" }): a modal dialog is blocking TouchDesigner's main thread. The seasons page is served by that same frozen thread, so the mini's fetch times out ("The operation was aborted due to timeout") even though the port still accepts TCP connections (devices.seasons_page is true). The probe's own checks are real: both boxes, both cameras, the router and the internet answer, and the LED display is attached. With TD frozen no Art-Net goes out: the rope boxes fall back to their own colour-cycling program and the panels keep their last frame. The probe took longer (its time is 24 s before the answer arrived).

expect.headline: TouchDesigner is frozen: the ropes are not being driven (someone must answer the dialog on bitcube)

items.bitcube: ok: online over Tailscale, up 3.1 h, 676 GB free
items.touchdesigner: down: no answer from the TD bridge (a dialog is blocking it)
items.seasons: down: the control page times out (TD is frozen); its port still accepting connections proves nothing
items.ropes: down: not driven; the boxes play their own colour cycle
items.hub75 panels: warning: LED display present but the picture is frozen
items.gallery camera: ok: reachable, clips posting, still 25 s old
items.river camera: ok: reachable, clips posting (the seasons file does not use it)
items.modal agent: ok: ticked a minute ago, next tick in the future
items.modal link: ok: 8 processes, gallery and river clips seconds old

expect.action: Look at bitcube's console over VNC and answer the dialog, or restart TouchDesigner on the seasons file with Switch now in mission control (about a minute dark).

seasons.error: The operation was aborted due to timeout

td.error: no answer from the TD bridge
